DARTLING.description: Barbed Dart adds 2 Poison if its hand has a pair.
DARTLING.name: Dartling

GEM_CULTIST.description: Restores the ally missing most HP when at least 5 HP is missing; otherwise attacks.
GEM_CULTIST.name: Gem Cultist

IRON_WARDEN.description: Alternates Fortify (self and group block) and Hammer.
IRON_WARDEN.name: Iron Warden

MIRROR_REGENT.description: Refraction → Shatter → Mending Glass. Below half HP: Refraction → Shatter. Resolve protects two slots after a stun skip.
MIRROR_REGENT.name: Mirror Regent

MIRROR_WISP.description: Reflection deals +4 if the target keeps its marked value.
MIRROR_WISP.name: Mirror Wisp

RED_SLIME.description: Stronger Strike, then Heal every turn.
RED_SLIME.name: Red Slime

RIFT_HOUND.description: Alternates Track and Pounce, targeting the hero with least block.
RIFT_HOUND.name: Rift Hound

RIFT_SOVEREIGN.description: High Tide → Low Tide → Eclipse. At 40% HP: High Tide and Low Tide each turn; safe total 19–23. Has Resolve.
RIFT_SOVEREIGN.name: Rift Sovereign

SLIME_KING.description: Slam → Fortify → Absorb. Resolve: after a stun skip, immune to external stun for two slots.
SLIME_KING.name: Slime King

ABANDONED_CACHE.description: Take 6 gold, or lose 8 HP for the displayed gem with +2 Carat. Requires more than 8 HP.
ABANDONED_CACHE.name: Abandoned Cache

ECHO_SHRINE.description: Take 5 gold, or replace one D6's faces with Paired, Odd, or Even faces.
ECHO_SHRINE.name: Echo Shrine

FIELD_MEDIC.description: Take 4 gold, or pay 8 gold to recover 20% maximum HP (rounded up).
FIELD_MEDIC.name: Field Medic

JEWEL_BROKER.description: Take 4 gold, or exchange one reserve gem for one of three displayed gems.
JEWEL_BROKER.name: Jewel Broker

ARDOR.description: Gain 2 block at the start of your turn when your final hand contains a pair.
ARDOR.name: Ardor

KAIT.description: Gain 3 block when a die finishes at least 4 higher than its initial value this turn.
KAIT.name: Kait

MAX.description: Once per encounter, reroll one die without spending your normal reroll.
MAX.name: Max

FIELD_DRESSING.description: Your first positive ordinary heal to an injured recipient each turn gains +2 healing.
FIELD_DRESSING.name: Field Dressing

FOCUSING_PRISM.description: Straight skills use +1 effective Clarity, up to 5.
FOCUSING_PRISM.name: Focusing Prism

LASTING_AEGIS.description: Carry up to 6 remaining block from a won battle into the next. Unequipping discards stored block.
LASTING_AEGIS.name: Lasting Aegis

MATCHBOX.description: Your Block gem grants +2 block once per actor turn.
MATCHBOX.name: Matchbox

MERCHANT_SEAL.description: Gain +3 gold from each normal or elite battle reward.
MERCHANT_SEAL.name: Merchant's Seal

MINERS_LANTERN.description: Gain 2 extra mining energy while alive.
MINERS_LANTERN.name: Miner's Lantern

STEADY_HAND.description: Strike deals +2 raw damage when no die was rerolled this turn.
STEADY_HAND.name: Steady Hand

TINKERS_BELT.description: Your first Workshop service each act is free. One service per visit.
TINKERS_BELT.name: Tinker's Belt

ARC_BURST.formula: Damage (highest value of chosen straight + F(L)) × M(C) to up to K+1 distinct enemies. Extra targets do not add hits on a single boss.
ARC_BURST.name: Arc Burst

BASTION.formula: Party block (3K + F(L)) × M(C) to every living hero, then clear 1 stun (2 at L5) from every living hero.
BASTION.name: Bastion

BLESSING.formula: Gain 3 × M(C) gold, then self heal (K + F(L)) × M(C).
BLESSING.name: Blessing

BLOCK.formula: Self block (highest pair value × K + F(L)) × M(C).
BLOCK.name: Block

BULWARK.formula: Carat reads a fixed 10–300 block table instead of M(C); self-stun at Cut 1–5: 3/2/2/1/0. Clarity only eases the trigger.
BULWARK.name: Bulwark

DRAINSTRIKE.formula: Damage (floor(H × (K+1)/2) + F(L)) × M(C), then self heal F(L) × M(C).
DRAINSTRIKE.name: Drain Strike

ECHO.formula: Repeat the last gem before this one that landed an amount, at (25 + 5(K−1) + F(L)) × M(C) percent of it, up to 200%. It repeats damage, block, healing, gold and statuses only.
ECHO.name: Echo

ENERVATE.formula: Remove up to (2K + F(L)) × M(C) block, then apply floor(matched value / 2) + K Poison (12 stack cap).
ENERVATE.name: Enervate

EVEN_TEMPO.formula: Self block (even result count × K + F(L)) × M(C); damage (K + F(L)) × M(C).
EVEN_TEMPO.name: Even Tempo

FACET.formula: Once per encounter, permanently raise the Carat of your lowest-Carat other equipped gem by ceil(K/2), never past this gem's own Carat of C.
FACET.name: Facet
FACET.trigger: At least 5 distinct results (4 at L3–4; 3 at L5)

GLIMMER.formula: Raise your lowest die by (K + F(L)) × M(C), to a maximum of 20. Every gem equipped after this one reads the raised hand.
GLIMMER.name: Glimmer

GRAFT.formula: Self heal (both pair values + 2(K−1) + F(L)) × M(C).
GRAFT.name: Graft

HEAL.formula: Self heal (lowest K dice + F(L)) × M(C).
HEAL.name: Heal

HEAVYSTRIKE.formula: Damage (highest triple value × K + F(L)) × M(C).
HEAVYSTRIKE.name: Heavy Strike

HEXBOLT.formula: Damage (odd result count × K + F(L)) × M(C). At L5, apply 1 stun.
HEXBOLT.name: Hex Bolt

INTERPOSE.formula: Party block (highest pair value + K−1 + F(L)) × M(C) to every living hero.
INTERPOSE.name: Interpose

LIFELINE.formula: Once per encounter revive a downed ally for (3K + F(L)) × M(C) HP; otherwise heal every living hero (K + F(L)) × M(C). Revived allies act next turn.
LIFELINE.name: Lifeline
LIFELINE.trigger: Straight: 5 at L1–2; 4 at L3–4; 3 at L5

LUCKYSTRIKE.formula: Each 7: 7 × M(K) × M(C) damage, then C × J gold. Three or more sevens: J=L+1 (7 at L5); otherwise J=1. The jackpot multiplies gold only.
LUCKYSTRIKE.name: Lucky Strike

MEND.formula: Party heal (lowest odd + 2(K−1) + F(L)) × M(C) to every living hero.
MEND.name: Mend

MIASMA.formula: Apply K+ceil(C/6) Poison to up to K+1 distinct enemies, then damage F(L) × M(C) to the same enemies (12 stack cap).
MIASMA.name: Miasma

MINT.formula: Gain (2K + F(L)) × M(C) gold, then self block (K + F(L)) × M(C).
MINT.name: Mint
MINT.trigger: At least 5 distinct results (4 at L3–4; 3 at L5)

MULTISTRIKE.formula: K hits of 4 × M(C) damage. Clarity shortens the straight instead of adding F(L). Target stays fixed for this skill.
MULTISTRIKE.name: Multistrike
MULTISTRIKE.trigger: Straight: 5 at L1–2; 4 at L3–4; 3 at L5

PURGE.formula: Clear K + ceil(C/8) Poison from every living hero, then party heal F(L) × M(C).
PURGE.name: Purge

QUARTET.formula: Damage (matched value × 2K + F(L)) × M(C). Clarity buys the trigger down to a triple instead of adding its flat bonus at L5.
QUARTET.name: Quartet
QUARTET.trigger: At least four matching values (three at L5)

REFRACT.formula: Raise your highest die by (H + 2(K−1) + F(L)) × M(C), to a maximum of 20 — enough to at least double it. Every gem equipped after this one reads the raised hand.
REFRACT.name: Refract

SECOND_SIGHT.formula: Raise your rerolls per turn to 2 + floor(C/8) for the rest of this battle, +1 at K5, up to 4. It sets the allowance rather than adding to it. Then gain F(L) × M(C) block.
SECOND_SIGHT.name: Second Sight

SHIELDBASH.formula: Gain F(L) × M(C) block, then damage floor(current block × (K+1)/2). At L5, apply 1 stun.
SHIELDBASH.name: Shield Bash
SHIELDBASH.trigger: Three of one value and two of another

STUN.formula: Damage (H + F(L)) × M(C), then 1 stun (2 at K5). K2–4 do not improve duration.
STUN.name: Stun

SUNDER.formula: Remove up to (2K + F(L)) × M(C) block; damage (highest pair value + F(L)) × M(C).
SUNDER.name: Sunder

VENOM.formula: Damage (floor(H/2) + F(L)) × M(C); apply K+ceil(C/4) Poison (12 stack cap).
VENOM.name: Venom

WAGER.formula: Gain 3 × M(C) gold, then damage (24 − total + 2K + F(L)) × M(C). The less the hand gave you, the harder this lands.
WAGER.name: Wager

poison.description: End-slot damage bypasses block, including a stunned slot. Lose one stack after ticking.
poison.name: Poison

resolve.description: Bosses reject external stun for two slots after a stun skip.
resolve.name: Resolve

stun.description: Skip the next actor slot; ticks before the skill batch. Self-stun affects future slots.
stun.name: Stun
